name: 33181 · North Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33181 (North Miami) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33181 (North Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33181 (North Miami) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33181 (North Miami) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
